points.description: States that the algorithm is implemented (written as a program and run) and its actual/physical running time is measured (e.g., with a clock/timer) .
points.partial_credit: Half-credit if only one half is stated, e.g., 'run the algorithm and see how long it takes' without mentioning implementing it, or 'implement it' with vague/no mention of measuring time.

points.description: Indicates the measurement is of real elapsed (physical) time, e.g., in seconds/milliseconds using a timer or system clock, rather than counting operations or analysing theoretically.
points.partial_credit: Half-credit if time is measured but the way is vague or mixed with a minor error.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying the algorithm is implemented/run as a program and its real running time is measured, in any wording, even briefly. Part marks for answers giving only half (just implement, or just 'time it' vaguely). No marks for answers describing theoretical analysis, counting primitive operations, or Big-O only.
